class.name: BulletSpawner2D
class.brief_description: Fires volleys of directional bullets on a timer using a [BulletFactory2D].
class.description: Place this node in the scene, point [member bullet_factory_path] at a [BulletFactory2D], assign [member spawn_data], and pick a [member transforms_source]: arrange marker nodes under [member transforms_generator], or generate the volley procedurally with the helper_* options (same patterns as the [BulletFactory2D] spawn helpers). Every [member shoot_interval_sec] seconds (after [member shoot_initial_delay_sec]) it collects one global transform per volley bullet and spawns them through [method BulletFactory2D.spawn_controllable_directional_bullets]. Each volley duplicates the spawn data first, so shared .tres files are never mutated. Never shoots in the editor.

method.name: collect_spawn_transforms
method.description: Collects one global transform per volley bullet according to [member transforms_source]: the [Node2D] children of the transforms generator, this node's own transform, or one of the procedural helper patterns (grid, ring, fan, spiral, line, aimed). Child and self modes fall back to the generator's own transform when it has no Node2D children; when no generator is assigned, this node's own transform is used. Always returns at least one transform, except aimed mode with no target (prints an error, volley skipped). [member transforms_scale] is applied to every source relative to the generator.

method.name: get_bullet_factory
method.description: Returns the resolved [BulletFactory2D] from [member bullet_factory_path], or null when the path is empty or the target is gone. A node of the wrong type produces a warning and resolves to null.

method.name: get_transforms_generator
method.description: Returns the resolved transforms generator behind [member transforms_generator], or null when unset. Falls back to nothing - [method collect_spawn_transforms] uses this node itself then.

method.name: get_helper_aimed_target
method.description: Returns the resolved aim target behind [member helper_aimed_target], or null when unset. Aimed mode with no target prints an error and skips the volley.

method.name: get_volleys_fired
method.description: How many volleys were fired since the last (re)arm. Reset by [method reset_shooting].

method.name: reset_shooting
method.description: Zeroes the volley counter, re-arms the timer with [member shoot_initial_delay_sec], and resumes processing when shooting is active. Emits [signal shooting_started] when it arms shooting.

method.name: set_bullet_factory
method.description: Assigns the [BulletFactory2D] directly and syncs [member bullet_factory_path] to it when both nodes are in the tree. Pass null to clear both.

method.name: set_transforms_generator
method.description: Assigns the transforms generator directly and syncs [member transforms_generator] to it when both nodes are in the tree. Pass null to clear both.

method.name: set_helper_aimed_target
method.description: Assigns the aim target directly and syncs [member helper_aimed_target] to it when both nodes are in the tree. Pass null to clear both.

method.name: shoot_once
method.description: Fires one volley immediately, counting it and re-arming the timer. Returns false (and prints an error) when misconfigured - no factory, no spawn data - or when the factory refuses (busy, tearing down, bad data). Manual shots bypass the [member max_volleys] cap but still count toward it.

members.member: Path to the [BulletFactory2D] used for spawning. Stored unfiltered so every node in the scene is pickable; the typed pointer resolves on demand with a runtime type check.

Volleys after which auto-shooting stops. -1 means infinite, 0 means it never fires automatically (manual [method shoot_once] still works). Lowering it at or below [method get_volleys_fired] emits [signal shooting_finished]; raising it back up re-emits [signal shooting_started].
Delay in seconds before the first volley after (re)arming. Must be finite and >= 0.
Seconds between automatic volleys. Must be finite and > 0.
Master switch for automatic shooting. Toggling it emits [signal shooting_started] / [signal shooting_stopped] on transitions. Manual [method shoot_once] works regardless.
The directional bullet data each volley is spawned with. Duplicated per volley with fresh transforms, so a shared resource is safe to assign.
Path to the Node2D whose children provide per-volley spawn transforms. Native Node2D filtering always matches, so any Node2D in the scene is selectable.

Uniform scale applied to every generated transform, relative to the generator origin - marker offsets (spread radius) and basis (bullet size) grow together while rotation is preserved. 1.0 is identity. Must be finite; 0 collapses the whole volley onto the generator, negatives mirror it.

Where [method collect_spawn_transforms] gets the per-volley transforms: 0 children of the transforms generator, 1 this spawner's own transform, 2+ procedural patterns driven by the helper_* options below. Only the option group of the active pattern is shown in the inspector (switching modes refreshes it immediately). Every mode produces a static snapshot per volley - Spiral places bullets along an expanding spiral facing radially outward, Line centers a wall on the generator facing the line axis, and Aimed centers a cone on [member helper_aimed_target] (the volley is skipped with an error when no target is assigned).
How many transforms the active procedural pattern generates. Clamped to >= 1.
Grid pattern: rows per column. Clamped to >= 1.
Grid pattern: anchor alignment, same values as [enum BulletFactory2D.Alignment].
Grid pattern: horizontal spacing between columns.
Grid pattern: vertical spacing between rows.
Grid pattern: rotate the grid with the generator's rotation.
Grid pattern: give each transform a random rotation.
Ring pattern: circle radius around the generator.
Ring pattern: angle in radians where the arc starts.
Ring pattern: arc length in radians. Full circle by default; smaller values make partial arcs.
Ring pattern: rotate the ring with the generator's rotation.
Ring pattern: give each transform a random rotation.
Ring pattern: face transforms away from the center. Set false for implosion patterns that fly toward the center.
Fan pattern: full cone width in radians.
Fan pattern: cone center direction in radians.
Fan pattern: stagger between consecutive origins so pellets do not stack.
Spiral pattern: radius of the first transform.
Spiral pattern: radius growth per transform.
Spiral pattern: angle step in radians per transform.
Spiral pattern: rotate the spiral with the generator's rotation.
Line pattern: the line axis. Need not be normalized.
Line pattern: spacing between consecutive transforms.
Line pattern: face transforms along the line axis instead of keeping the generator rotation.
Path to the Node2D the aimed cone is centered on (generator-to-target direction). Native Node2D filtering always matches, so any Node2D in the scene is selectable.
Aimed pattern: full cone width in radians around the generator-to-target direction.
Aimed pattern: stagger between consecutive origins so pellets do not stack.

constants.constant: Per-volley transforms come from the Node2D children of the transforms generator.
Every volley fires a single bullet from the generator's own transform.
Per-volley transforms come from the procedural grid pattern and its helper_grid_* options.
Per-volley transforms come from the procedural ring pattern and its helper_ring_* options.
Per-volley transforms come from the procedural fan pattern and its helper_fan_* options.
Per-volley transforms come from the procedural spiral pattern and its helper_spiral_* options.
Per-volley transforms come from the procedural line pattern and its helper_line_* options.
Per-volley transforms come from the aimed cone at [member helper_aimed_target] and its helper_aimed_* options.

signal.name: area_entered
signal.description: Emitted synchronously in the physics tick when a bullet from a volley spawned by this spawner enters a physics area. Only fires for this spawner's own volleys (factory-spawned bullets report to the factory signals instead). Same handler contract as the factory collision signals: game logic is safe directly, structural factory calls must be deferred.

signal.name: body_entered
signal.description: Emitted synchronously in the physics tick when a bullet from a volley spawned by this spawner enters a physics body. Only fires for this spawner's own volleys; same handler contract as above.

signal.name: life_time_over
signal.description: Emitted (deferred, outside the physics step) when a volley spawned by this spawner expires, but only if [member MultiMeshBulletsData2D.is_life_time_over_signal_enabled] is set. Only fires for this spawner's own volleys.

signal.name: shooting_finished
signal.description: Emitted exactly when the volley cap is reached - by the volley that hits [member max_volleys], or by lowering [member max_volleys] to or below the fired count. Manual shots past the cap do not re-emit it.

signal.name: shooting_started
signal.description: Emitted when automatic shooting arms: on scene ready, on [method reset_shooting], when [member shooting_enabled] flips on, and when raising [member max_volleys] resumes a stopped spawner. Connect after this spawner's own ready (e.g. from the parent) to catch the initial arm.

signal.name: shooting_stopped
signal.description: Emitted when automatic shooting disarms via [member shooting_enabled] flipping off. Cap-driven stops emit [signal shooting_finished] instead.

signal.name: volley_fired
signal.description: Emitted for every successful volley, automatic or manual. The typed instance lets handlers drive homing, attachments, or patterns immediately with no casts; volley_index is 1-based (use it for wave logic or chaining spawners).
